lanes.label: Complete text with explicit media omissions

cards.title: Approved scope
items: Images, videos, GIFs, audio and other attachments are presence metadata, never assessment evidence.
No CDN download, media-only X hydration, vision request or new image reservation. Text-only posts still require sufficient complete text.
Quoted and embedded text, full Article bodies, connected threads and existing source/identity limits remain required.

cards.title: Persistence and recovery
items: Migration 000019 stores omission metadata beside owner-scoped source text. NULL preserves unknown historical/manual scope; an empty list records new text-only scope.
Research metadata is separate from text passages. Existing analyses and billed image attempts are not rewritten, retried or refunded.
Apply migration before matching backend/frontend deployment. This is a behavior contract, not a frozen repository map.

cards.title: Embedded Article text
items: Accept and validate entities.tweets and entities.posts; deduplicate IDs and reuse returned posts. Missing embedded text gets one official lookup, including nested Article embeds.

Embedded lookups and thread search share twelve requests, one hundred posts and sixty seconds. Failed requests, cycles, conflicting versions and incomplete text request paste, never partial assessment.
Missing ordinary quote/repost expansions still request paste. Extra X reads use existing submission or Retry consent; media remain metadata.

cards.title: Automatic partial previews — migration 000021
items: Readable incomplete fragments can receive one automatic sentence under explicit Submit/Retry cost disclosure, consent and shared-budget admission. No extra Generate button.
The preview is owned item metadata, not complete source or assessment input. Needs action, pasted-content recovery and no-score rules remain. Unknown charges disable Retry until reconciled.
The Automatic Partial Preview Contract documents admission, one-attempt recovery and empty/failure paths; older jobs default to no preview consent.
